segments.title: What if sending dollars felt like sending a text?
segments.subtitle: NivPay, in test mode

segments.plan: Phone A, welcome screen: type the name, Create your account, the passkey sheet, fingerprint, Home
segments.caption: A brand new account, made with a passkey
segments.callout: No password, no app to install. {cast.eddy.name}'s phone.

segments.plan: Phone A, Home: Your balance, Dollars $0.00, Held as AUSD, a digital dollar issued by Agora
segments.caption: Its balance is in AUSD, a digital dollar from Agora

segments.plan: Phone A, Add test dollars: Getting your account ready, fingerprint, Adding test dollars
segments.caption: Add test dollars

segments.plan: Phone A: Added $10,000 test dollars. Settled in 0.Xs. Dollars $10,000.00
segments.caption: {bounty.testDollars} in AUSD. Settled in {measured.claimSettle}
segments.callout: Test dollars from Agora's faucet, not real money

segments.plan: Phone B, Maya's Receive: Amount to ask for 25, Copy link, paste it into the chat to phone A
segments.caption: {cast.maya.name} asks for {bounty.send} with a link

segments.plan: Phone A: open the link, Send dollars with 25 filled in, Sending to account ending ####, Review: Amount $25, Fee None
segments.caption: Sending to the account ending {measured.recipientLastFour}

segments.plan: Both phones in step: A sends $25 with the fingerprint to Payment final; B shows +$25.00 from account ending, Just arrived
segments.caption: Sent and received. Settled in {measured.sendSettle}

segments.plan: Phone A, held on Payment final: Sent $25 to Maya. Settled in 0.Xs.
segments.caption: Settled in {measured.sendSettle}, measured on the phone

segments.plan: Phone A, View receipt: MonadVision opens the transfer of 25 AUSD to Maya's account, finalized
segments.caption: The receipt on Monad: {bounty.send} in AUSD

segments.plan: Phone A: the same request link, How much 10, They receive CTK, the line on what CTK is, Review
segments.caption: Pay in another currency: {bounty.otherCurrency}
segments.callout: {bounty.otherCurrency} is a test currency from Agora, standing in for a local currency

segments.plan: Phone A: Send $10 as CTK, one fingerprint, Step 1 of 3, Step 2 of 3, Step 3 of 3
segments.caption: One fingerprint, three steps, each final before the next

segments.plan: A: Sent $10 to Maya. They received 10.00 CTK. Settled in 0.Xs. B: +10.00 CTK from Agora's settlement
segments.caption: {cast.maya.name} receives {measured.otherCurrencyReceived}. Settled in {measured.otherCurrencySettle}
